feature: Customer Portal (artifacts/portal) -- SOPs & Runbooks (/sops, /runbooks), wired to real data (#2994, carried forward from #1730/#1493/#1488). Design: Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/SOPs.dc.html. Real endpoints: GET/POST /api/portal/sops, GET /api/portal/sop-runs, POST /api/portal/sops/:sopId/custom-steps (routes/portal-sops.ts, requireRole('CustomerUser')), and GET /api/portal/runbooks + the hold-window writes (routes/portal-runbooks.ts, requireRole('Assessment')) via the pre-existing, previously-unconsumed useRunbooks.ts/useHoldBadge.ts hooks. No fixture data anywhere -- a genuinely empty runbooks/holds table for this tenant renders the design's own honest-empty copy, not a fabricated row.
notes: artifacts/msp-portal (the old '/portal-v2/*' surface, including test-manifests/portal/portal-v2-sops.json) was retired for artifacts/portal in f40438cdc (#1921). This manifest covers the REPLACEMENT pages at the new, un-slugged routes /portal/sops and /portal/runbooks -- it is not an update of portal-v2-sops.json, which tests a page that no longer exists in the tree.

NO LOGIN PAGE EXISTS YET IN artifacts/portal (see App.tsx's own RequireAuth comment: 'Until a login page is rebuilt under its own issue, an unauthenticated visitor sees an honest sign-in-required panel'). So unlike the old portal-v2-* manifests, this one CANNOT drive a real #email/#password uiSteps login -- there is no form to fill in. The uiSteps below therefore assert the one thing that IS real and reachable without auth: that /portal/sops and /portal/runbooks resolve to the app's own RequireAuth gate (data-testid='require-auth-panel'), not a 404 or a route that doesn't exist. Once a real login page ships for this app, add an authenticated uiSteps block here following the same #email/#password/login-submit pattern test-manifests/portal/portal-v2-overview.json already proves, then assert the real page content (data-testid='sops-page' / 'runbooks-page' and their tab/row testids, all already present in the shipped components).

apiTests below ARE fully authenticated (via the real POST /api/auth/login + Bearer token, same as every other portal manifest) and were hand-verified live against this environment before being written: GET /api/portal/sops returned 15 real msp_sops rows for the testbed account (customerId 1), GET /api/portal/sop-runs returned an empty queue + 15 real 'Version published' audit rows, GET /api/portal/runbooks returned a genuinely empty {runbooks:[],holds:[],summary:{...,text:'No hold windows'}} for this tenant (0 rows in portal_runbooks/portal_hold_windows at verification time -- a live-empty state, not a bug), and both POST /api/portal/sops and POST /api/portal/sops/:sopId/custom-steps were exercised for real and their written rows re-read back correctly shaped.

A3c/A3d create a real 'ours'-source SOP row and a real custom-step overlay row on it, same pattern portal-v2-sops.json's own A3c/A3d used -- these are additive, idempotent-safe re-runs (a fresh row each time, never deleted), not destructive.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
